summary: This bill grants temporary protected status and employment authorization to certain Iranian nationals in the U.S. who have been affected by a December 2025 pause in immigration application adjudications, due to armed hostilities and human rights abuses in Iran.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on providing temporary protected status and employment authorization to a specific group of Iranian nationals already in the United States. It aims to prevent their removal and allow them to work due to ongoing conflict in Iran and a U.S. adjudication pause, which clearly facilitates more immigration (albeit temporary) for this group.
